sourceMeaning: PilotRpc.accountControlBytes charges passive websocket receipt to the same ComponentBudget byte counter; therefore this reported field includes HTTP/control-WS accounting rather than exclusively HTTP body bytes.
reportingRule: Keep reported field provenance. Never add it to nativeStreamBytes or label it host wire throughput. ActualhostNetwork kernelmeasurements include unrelatedhosttraffic and are separatelylabelled.
affectedEvidence: All original-source snapshots and derived forward windows preserve the actual counter name/value; this note clarifies semantics without replacing evidence.
